description.value: Pacific Crest is a hike-in backcountry campground in E.C. Manning Park's Cascade Mountains, more than 1 km from any road and sitting near the northern terminus of the Pacific Crest Trail. A nightly permit ($5/person) is required but no advance reservation is needed; no cellphone service anywhere in the park.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a backcountry tent campsite (backcountry=yes, tents=yes, capacity:tents=4) within E.C. Manning Park. The BC Parks website confirms Pacific Crest is one of the designated backcountry campgrounds in the park, requiring a permit but not a formal reservation — it is not listed among the three campgrounds (Buckhorn, Kicking Horse, Frosty Creek) that accept peak-season reservations. No amenity detail specific to Pacific Crest (water, shelter, food storage) is given on the website, which covers all Manning backcountry sites collectively.
concerns: Website covers all Manning Park backcountry campgrounds collectively — no amenity details specific to Pacific Crest campground (water, shelter, food storage) could be confirmed.
No address, phone, or email available in OSM or on the website for this specific campsite.
Site is backcountry (>1 km from any road), which may limit accessibility for loaded road-touring cyclists versus bike-packers.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, operating BC Parks backcountry campsite suitable for bike-packers and self-supported touring cyclists traversing E.C. Manning Park; the listing would be useful for route planning despite minimal amenities.
enrichment_extras.notes: Permit registration is mandatory for all overnight stays; registration is available at camping.bcparks.ca, by calling 1-800-689-9025, or in person at the Manning Park visitor centre, Manning Park Lodge, or Lightning Lake gatehouse. The park has no cellphone service.
